through_line.name: the fried Oreo
through_line.prop_prompt: a round deep-fried batter ball on a short wooden stick, split open to show a dark cookie inside, dusted heavily with white powdered sugar
progression: a round battered shape on a stick, descending
powdered sugar falling ahead of it like snow
the fried Oreo lands and introduces itself
the floor is coated white with sugar
five more descend in a row
a funnel cake shape appears above them all

blocks.through_line_state: a round battered shape on a stick, descending
blocks.sfx: a fryer sizzle, a light dusting patter, a swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes bracing before he asks
CLOSE, low angle: Gut half asleep, opening one eye
MEDIUM, high angle: a round battered shape on a stick coming down
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut fully awake now

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Gut. I have a question.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Make it a fast one.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: What happens if six fried Oreos arrive?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Six? On a stick? At a fair?

blocks.through_line_state: powdered sugar falling ahead of it like snow
blocks.sfx: a soft dusting patter, a scrape, a creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut shouting up through falling white powder
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes coated white, blinking sugar away
MEDIUM, high angle: powder drifting down the whole length of the tube
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes, entirely white-dusted

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Absolutely not. Nothing fried comes down.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There's powdered sugar on them too.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: How much powdered sugar, Pipes?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: It's less sugar, more of a coating.

blocks.through_line_state: the fried Oreo lands and introduces itself
blocks.sfx: a heavy greasy splat, a sugar puff, a cheerful chirp
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the fried ball landing with the stick still in it
CLOSE, low angle: two delighted eyes opening in the batter
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut staring at the wooden stick
CLOSE on the eyes: the Oreo beaming, Gut horrified

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You are dripping on everything.

turns.speaker: fried_oreo
turns.line: Fresh out the fryer, friend!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There is a stick in you.

turns.speaker: fried_oreo
turns.line: Wooden! Don't worry about the stick!

blocks.through_line_state: the floor is coated white with sugar
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a distant fairground organ, a hum
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ scrolling, faintly appalled
CLOSE, low angle: the phone screen lighting HQ's face
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ holding the phone out at arm's length
CLOSE on HQ's eyes going flat

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, tell me what that is.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: A cookie. Battered. Then fried.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Why would anybody build that?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: There's a line. A very long line.

blocks.through_line_state: five more descend in a row
blocks.sfx: a capsule toss, a heavy thud, a ragged breath
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Pancho arriving with sleeves already rolled
MEDIUM, eye level: Pancho winding up and throwing a small blue capsule
MEDIUM, high angle: five more shapes descending behind Gut
CLOSE on the eyes: Pancho seeing the five and giving up

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Pancho. We need you. Right now.

turns.speaker: pancho
turns.line: Insulin, going out. That's one.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There are five more coming down.

turns.speaker: pancho
turns.line: Five? That's fine. I'm cooked.

blocks.through_line_state: a funnel cake shape appears above them all
blocks.sfx: a distant fryer hiss, one low rumble, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel, dusted faintly white
CLOSE, low angle: Gut exhaling, finished
MEDIUM, high angle: a wide flat shape appearing in the opening above
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty watching it come

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's it. That was the last one.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: There's a funnel cake now.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Rusty. Don't do that to me.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: I don't make the plans.
